🎬 3×3 (2009)

3×3 is a comedy-drama short film that turns a simple basketball game into an entertaining battle of intelligence, creativity, and unexpected talent. When a janitor and a security guard cross paths in a gymnasium, an unusual basketball challenge unfolds. What starts as an ordinary encounter becomes a clever competition involving mathematics, physics, and surprising shooting techniques. As the two men try to outsmart each other, the film delivers humorous moments while showing how intelligence and creativity can transform an everyday sport into something extraordinary.

Combining visual comedy, basketball, and inventive problem-solving, the film celebrates thinking outside the box and finding unexpected ways to succeed.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Short Film

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 6 minutes

🎥 Director: Nuno Rocha

🏆 Recognition: This Portuguese short film became known online as How an Engineer Plays Basketball, gaining attention for its clever visual humor and creative basketball tricks.

📺 Where to Watch: Search for 3x3 – How an Engineer Plays Basketball on YouTube. Availability may vary.
